name: Ricochet Garden — Field
invitation: A timber bank stands in a staggered field of metal and timber plates. A shot can leave the first surface toward a different later one. There is no target. The shot can change, and the bank can move.
physicalQuestion: Which contact orders can ordinary aim reach when one surface sends the ball toward different later surfaces, and what changes when the timber bank is moved?
nearbySensitivity: The aim sliders step yaw and elevation by 0.5° and charge by 0.01. At yaw 7°, elevation 14°, and charge 0.6 the ball touches the timber bank, then the left plate. Yaw 6.5° and 7.5°, elevation 13.5° and 14.5°, and charge 0.59 and 0.61 keep that order. This is the neighbourhood of that two-contact shot.
validationEvidence: 3240 headless Havok shots, seed 20261109, on a uniform aim grid at the preset pose, plus slider-step neighbours of the tested shots and a reduced grid on moved bank poses. The validator replays the tested shots. Grid counts are not human success rates. Enjoyment, a physical phone, and speaker playback were not run.

limitations.concept: A third contact that is still in the air after the second surface.
limitations.missing: Pieces have no height offset, a plate is 4 m tall, and first ground ends the line. Most exits from the timber bank reach the ground after one later plate.
limitations.extension: One height offset on the existing plate, keeping its friction and restitution. Do not change first-ground termination.

limitations.concept: A recorded note of which neighbouring slider steps stay in a contact order.
limitations.missing: The validator replays the tested shots. It does not search neighbouring aims on its own.
limitations.extension: Leave the replay as it is. A later check can append neighbour setups to testedShots when the launcher is free.

limitations.concept: Hear the timber bank with the existing H voice, plates staying on their materials, and read the contact order.
limitations.missing: This manifest opts in to the existing face-speed dynamics, the H timber-bank voice, and the note timeline. Listening on a real speaker is not checked here.
limitations.extension: No new sound engine. A later pass can keep these fields and only retune the existing H voice.

limitations.concept: The staggered field reads from the survey view on a phone.
limitations.missing: Survey does not label the pieces, and a physical phone was not used for this check.
limitations.extension: A one-line caption under Survey, with no new geometry.
